central_hypothesis: At matched information, compute, memory, and communication budgets, a distributed controller can preserve intended identity and critical capabilities while adapting its representation and interaction topology under damage and uncertainty.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Represent target intent as a provenance-bound admissible region/equivalence class with explicit invariants rather than one exact mask.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: No held-out gain over matched template control, or elevated false acceptance.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Separate current morphology inference, remembered target identity, repair selection, outcome observation, and abstention.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: Trusted target memory does not improve recovery under equal information, or confident errors remain high.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Compare fixed topology, adaptive edge weights, and adaptive topology under matched degree and communication budgets.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: Topology learning has no independent held-out benefit after matching work/messages or relies on leakage.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Separate fast local, intermediate coordination, and slow distributed-history channels; gate expensive channels conditionally.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: Benefits vanish under compute/message matching, temporal shuffling, or memory-irrelevant controls.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Choose among act, sense, diagnose, defer, and abstain based on downstream decision value and acquisition cost.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: Active sensing does not reduce wrong repair or total cost versus equal-observation baseline.

paradigm_hypotheses.mechanism: Optimize task-native capabilities and invariants in addition to geometric resemblance.
paradigm_hypotheses.falsifier: Function measures add no valid signal or are evaluator-leaky.
